title: QuestionTranslation
description: The research question translated into one English sentence (D149). Asked only when the question is not English and the person gave no key terms; code then picks the search words from this sentence. The sentence must read as English: one that does not is an invalid output.

english_question.description: The question as one faithful English sentence, in the field's English terms. Nothing added, narrowed or explained. No rationale field: free text would not be checked.
